Amendment 3 in force: two retrieval routes against one reference standard

Both open parameters settled by the author and the inspection statement
confirmed, so the amendment is appended to PREREGISTRATION.md section 7 and
takes effect with this commit.

  Arm B's seeds: option (b). The twelve Paiwan broadcast days split six and
  six, drawn by continuing the single default_rng(20261005) stream after every
  draw of Amendment 1, taking 6 of 12 without replacement in date order. Seeds
  are the reference-set utterances of the seed half; both arms are scored on
  the scoring half only. No Study 1 or Study 2 material supplies seeds, so
  section 2 item 6 is not engaged.

  The spot check: 40 tokens, ten from each of the four cells, superseding the
  25 of section 4 item 11, which was sized for a single set. A cell holding
  fewer than ten is checked in full and the shortfall recorded.

  The inspection statement: analysis/study3/README.md records that no Study 3
  content was inspected for any analysis purpose during collection, and the
  author confirmed this on 2026-10-05. The amendment is therefore written
  after collection and before any inspection, and says so.

The design: the reference standard is the Paiwan utterances whose time-aligned
TITV Chinese subtitle meets Study 2's rule-based directive criterion, a
published human translation judged by a stated rule, so no model judges force.
Arm A is the detector of section 4 item 10, unchanged, unwindowed, Paiwan
only. Arm B is query-by-example at the utterance by multimodal similarity.
Both return the same number of utterances, so k cannot advantage either. The
primary statistic is the fraction of the reference set reached by B and not by
A, bootstrapped at the broadcast day. A null is a reportable negative result
about the geometric route, not an under-determined outcome.

Withdrawn: the binarized Urging-versus-rest test and the lift statistic, and
with them the question of which direction to condition in.

Unchanged: section 4 item 10, the detector operating point; sections 1, 2, 3,
5; and the corpus.

AMENDMENT_3_DRAFT.md is marked superseded and kept as the drafting record,
with its two decision markers closed so nothing greps as open. Section 7 is
the only text that governs. The outline's 6.1 and 6.1.3 now say registered
rather than pending.

Lock the pre-registration for Study 3

All seven DRAFT VALUE items in PREREGISTRATION.md are confirmed unchanged
and the markers are removed. The status line now reads IN FORCE. This
commit is the one that puts the document in force, and it precedes any
inspection of the Study 3 corpus.

The seven values, as locked:
  1. default_rng(20261005), 3 of 10 clips per broadcast day, without
     replacement, fixed iteration order.
  2. A category is tested on its own only at >=15 broadcast days and
     >=25 clips; below that it is reported descriptively.
  3. No label-driven top-up. Up to 4 extra whole broadcast days per
     language, drawn by the same seeded rule, each entering every
     analysis rather than only the one that motivated it.
  4. The labeling unit is the utterance: the label unit follows the
     retrieval unit. Clip labels are retained for corpus description
     and for the dual-unit agreement rate.
  5. The audio stand-ins are music proportion (predicted higher for
     Celebrating) and speaker-change rate (predicted lower for
     Reporting), both declared as directional predictions.
  6. The spot check is 25 tokens, stratified by target and by
     Urging / not, fixed seed, drawn before any result is computed.
  7. The genetic-distance gradient is monotone non-increasing
     Short >= Middle >= Long. The primary test is Middle against Long,
     9 pairs against 5; Short holds exactly one pair and is reported
     descriptively only.

Consequent updates:
  - 00_dissertation_outline.md: open decisions 6 and 7 resolved and
    dated; decision 2's two remaining open items recorded as settled in
    the pre-registration.
  - writing_guide.md: hard line 2 and the W3 row record that the lock
    happened 2026-10-03, ahead of the W3 slot.

PREREGISTRATION.md is not edited from here on. Changes go in its section
7 as dated amendments.
